# Summary
### Chapter Key Takeaways

- Ownership rules ensure single ownership per resource and deterministic cleanup.
- Stack memory holds fixed-size data; heap memory holds dynamic data referenced via stack pointers.
- Move semantics transfer ownership, invalidating previous bindings to prevent double-free errors.
- `Copy` types duplicate automatically via bitwise copy; heap types require explicit `.clone()`.
- The `Drop` trait executes custom cleanup when a value leaves scope.
